goals.0: Saying you're looking for a flat: Ich suche eine Wohnung
goals.1: Asking about the rent: Kaltmiete, Nebenkosten
dialog.4.de.2.n: For rent: kalt = the rent alone, without extra costs
dialog.4.de.4.n: warm = the total rent including extra costs
dialog.6.de.4.n: möchte … sehen: the infinitive goes to the end of the sentence (just like in Bangla!)
grammar.0.title: Numbers 100 to 1000
grammar.0.note: Numbers are written as one word and read in the same order as before: hundreds → units before tens (dreihundertdreiundzwanzig). The thousands separator is a point: 1.000.
grammar.1.text: Kaltmiete = the rent for the flat only. Nebenkosten = extra costs for water, heating, rubbish collection and so on. Warmmiete = Kaltmiete + Nebenkosten. Check carefully which one an advert gives — 600 euros kalt and 600 euros warm are not the same thing.
grammar.2.title: Abbreviations in adverts
grammar.2.note: Example: „2-Zi.-Whg., 55 m², KM 600 €, NK 100 €“ = a two-room flat of 55 square metres, rent 600 euros, extra costs 100 euros.
quiz.6.why: Kaltmiete = the rent for the flat alone (without Nebenkosten).
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “I'm looking for a flat.”
